definitions.explanation: An article in a newspaper or magazine expressing the opinion of the editors or publisher.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}の{社説|しゃせつ}は{環境|かんきょう}{問題|もんだい}について{書|か}かれていた。
examples.english: Today's editorial was written about environmental issues.

examples.japanese: {社説|しゃせつ}を{読|よ}んで{考|かんが}えさせられた。
examples.english: I was made to think after reading the editorial.

examples.japanese: この{新聞|しんぶん}の{社説|しゃせつ}は{保守的|ほしゅてき}だ。

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{社説|しゃせつ}を{書|か}く (to write an editorial)
・{社説|しゃせつ}を{読|よ}む (to read an editorial)
・{社説|しゃせつ}{欄|らん} (editorial column)

RELATED WORDS:
・{論説|ろんせつ} - editorial, opinion piece (similar meaning)
・{記事|きじ} - article (neutral, factual)
・{コラム} - column (regular opinion piece by a specific writer)

{社説|しゃせつ} represents the official stance of the newspaper/magazine, while コラム represents an individual writer's opinion.

[Register: Formal]
